scope: First-time local TLS platform-service connection only. No owner enrollment, human verification, impersonation or public gateway activation.
actualPreflightCorrection: An initial prefix guard confused the existing platform-notices worker with the owner connection and refused before mutation. Replaced it with PostgreSQL parsed exact HBA identities; reproduced both the worker-prefix acceptance and exact-target refusal in runnable tests.
limitations: A prepared connection is not verified human owner enrollment or an enabled owner gateway.
Recovery acceptance is not entire-host reconstruction, permanent Google authorization or second-device recovery custody proof.
